label: Ludwig Wittgenstein
display_label: Later philosophy: selected writing and publication dates; reception separately
decision: Replace the inferred activity/reception bar with dated writing/publication markers. Retain the later-philosophy description, but do not make 1953 an activity endpoint or ‘Later’ a present-day instruction.

label: Roger Chartier
display_label: Selected contribution: Le monde comme représentation (1989)
decision: Use a publication point. ‘Representations’ has no temporal meaning and cannot create continuation. The selection does not define Chartier's career.

label: J. M. S. Careless
decision: Use discrete selected publications, with a separately qualified delivery date. Split the two Brown volumes instead of representing 1959–1963 as continuous production. The title's ‘Later’ cannot open the selection to the present.

label: Joy Parr
display_label: Selected publications, 1980–2010; Sensing Changes editions distinguished
decision: Keep a labelled selection of contributions rather than career bounds. Distinguish the 2009 hardcover release from the cited 2010 PDF edition; neither the book's 1953–2003 subject period nor a 2011 review dates Parr's career.

label: Sherry Olson
display_label: Selected contributions, 1979–2014; collective MAP project from 2000
decision: Use work points and a qualified project-foundation point, not a continuous career span. A project's establishment year does not date its undated repository description or its completion.

label: Aldo Leopold
display_label: Selected posthumous publication: A Sand County Almanac (1949); reception separately
decision: Keep the single-work point and identify it as posthumous. Add dated reception examples on a separate track rather than manufacturing a lifetime or continuous influence bar.

label: Annales
display_label: Journal founded 1929; selected Annales interventions and reassessments
decision: Treat 1929 as the founding editorial/journal milestone. Use selected interventions to show development and self-criticism; neither 1929 nor the review cutoff defines an unchanged school's duration.

label: Quantitative history
display_label: Selected quantitative-history contributions and institutions; distinct strands
decision: Do not treat ‘1950s–70s expansion’ as either a field lifespan or a precise common phase for serial history, historical demography and cliometrics. Plot sourced milestones across those strands; a common expansion interval remains unestablished.

label: Military history
display_label: Selected military-history interventions, with earlier works distinguished
decision: Use dated works with an explicit selective scope. Howard 1961 and Keegan 1976 are contributions to an older field, not its first and last years. Later memoir dates are evidence dates, not new personal interventions by Howard.

label: The Science Wars, 1994–2000
display_label: Science Wars: selected exchanges, 1994–1999; reassessments in 2000 and 2004
decision: Do not promote the old 2000 convenience cutoff into a historical terminus. Show selected exchanges and distinguish later reviews/retrospectives; the 2004 essay does not extend a continuous debate bar.

label: The 'Who Killed Canadian History?' debate
display_label: Canadian-history exchanges: selected texts from 1991–1992 and 1998–2000; earlier roots and later reassessment
decision: Preserve antecedents separately from the two principal exchanges and later reassessments. Keep the Bliss issue-date ambiguity rather than converting a conventional 1991 citation to a falsely exact beginning.

label: Indigenous history & decolonizing methods
display_label: Selected witnesses and contributions from distinct Indigenous historical traditions; c. 1615/1616–2010
decision: Show separate witnesses and interventions without joining them into one continuous academic-field bar. Keep manuscript creation, later editions, translations and collaborative practice distinct; the oldest witness is not the origin of Indigenous historical knowledge.

label: Digital history
display_label: Selected publications, 2003–2022; field origins and overall chronology unresolved
decision: Retain selected publication events and their source-specific claims. Do not render 2003 as a field foundation or 2022 as its ending; do not extend a solid field bar from the inherited 2000 review year.

label: Web history / Archived-web research
display_label: Selected publications, 2003–2026; web history and research using web archives distinguished
decision: Use individually dated methodological contributions with no universal origin/end. Keep the dates of fieldwork, publication and cited historical objects separate.

label: Comparative Studies in Society and History
display_label: Comparative Studies in Society and History: first issue October 1958; ending not established in this pilot
decision: The first-issue heading independently corroborates the catalogue's 1958 start. Record first issue separately from the publisher's 2009 digitization date; do not infer an ending or uninterrupted publication to the present.

label: Annales. Histoire, Sciences sociales
display_label: Annales HSS title from 1994; journal lineage from 1929; venue role separately evidenced
decision: Replace the conflation of earliest venue-role evidence and publication origin with distinct title and role events. Preserve the library's broader 1946 record as a lineage/identity observation rather than silently treating it as the exact current-title start.
